**Generalized Markov traces and Jucys-Murphy elements**

*Kostiantyn Tolmachov, Heorhii Zhylinskyi*

12 pp, 9 sections.

**Abstract.** WegiveasimpleconstructionofMarkovtracesforIwahori-Heckealgebrasassociated with infinite series of crystallographic Coxeter groups. In typesB and D it is new, and generalizes a known construction in typeA employing symmetric polynomials in multiplicative Jucys-Murphy elements.

**Outline.** Coxeter groups.; Introduction.; Iwahori-Hecke algebras.; Acknowledgments.; Iwahori-Hecke algebras and multiplicative Jucy; Some central elements in the classical Iwahori; Markov traces.; Markov traces via Jucys-Murphy elements.; Geometric Markov traces.
